name: check_skill
description: Check whether a skill directory complies with SKILL_STANDARDS.md and return a PASS/WARN/FAIL report.

skill_name.description: Target skill directory name under ithqbot/skills. Optional when bundle_path is provided.

strict.description: If true, treat recommended checks as blocking failures.

bundle_path.description: Path to a packaged skill archive (.zip/.tar/.tar.gz/.tgz/.tar.bz2/.tbz2/.tar.xz/.txz).
